title: security-intake-categorization-and-rapid-response-orchestrator
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Build an orchestrator that standardizes incoming enterprise security and compliance requests (SOC2/ISO questionnaires, HIPAA data handling checks, GDPR/DPA routing, third-party vendor questionnaires). Deliverables: canonical intake schema, LLM-assisted answer/evidence prefill with provenance, tiered acknowledgement & SLA mapping, and a rapid-response path for high-severity asks.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical intake schema published and stored in Confluence with examples for SOC2, DPA, HIPAA and ISO requests
Automated acknowledgement sent within 24 hours for >=95% of incoming tickets during pilot
LLM prefill produces suggested answers and evidence pointers with confidence scores exposed and >= 80% reviewer acceptance on pilot dataset (n=250)
High-severity items are routed to Legal+Security on-call within 1 business hour with automated blocking flag
Console ticket UI surfaces taxonomy labels, suggested owner, estimated effort (points), and prefill acceptance toggle
Telemetry surfaced: ack latency, routing accuracy, prefill acceptance rate, percentage of items escalated to legal
tasks: Define intake taxonomy (fields: request_type, data_scope, jurisdiction, evidence_type, urgency, initial_risk_score)
Create acknowledgement templates for fast-path (24h), standard (3d), and extended (10d) SLAs
Prototype LLM-assisted prefill service with provenance traces and confidence bands
Implement rule-based safety gates for data-residency and high-sensitivity keywords
Backend: intake webhook -> triage lambda -> Linear API ticket creation with structured payload
Frontend: triage card design and Console integration (mocks, accessibility review, QA)
Build evidence-bundle outline generator that maps request fields to internal templates and sample attachments
Instrument telemetry and add dashboard panels to the security intake dashboard
Pilot with 3 enterprise customers (SOC2, healthcare, EU e-comm) and iterate on taxonomy and templates
updates: 2025-02-17: Kickoff with Security, Legal, Support, and DX. Agreed on three SLA tiers and immediate need for data-residency gate.
2025-02-21: Draft taxonomy v0.1 reviewed; added 'consent_and_legal_basis' and 'third_party_flow' fields per Privacy feedback.

2025-02-27: LLM prefill alpha completed. Alpha notes: good recall for repeated questionnaire clauses, occasional fabricated Drive links. Action: show provenance and mark all suggestions as 'proposed'.
2025-03-01: Design delivered two triage card variants. Chosen compact card that emphasizes risk tier and likely owner. Accessibility pass scheduled.
2025-03-04: Legal required an approval gate for any auto-responders touching DPAs or data residency escalations. Workaround: block auto-response and surface recommended reply for reviewer.
2025-03-06: Updated plan to include pilot metrics and added ENG work to hard-fail on suspicious attachments during prefill. Preparing pilot onboarding checklist.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: LLM generates plausible but incorrect evidence links — Mitigation: surface provenance, confidence, and an explicit human-accept step before attachments are published
Risk: Misrouted GDPR/DPA tickets cause compliance exposure — Mitigation: conservative rule that forces manual legal gate on any ticket with EU jurisdiction or 'data-residency' flags
Risk: Customers receive overly technical acknowledgements — Mitigation: craft customer-facing templates with Communications and validate tone in pilot
Risk: Increased workload from false-positive high-risk flags — Mitigation: tune triage scorer with pilot data and provide 'reclassify' quick action for reviewers
